backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.hint: An exact, complete copy of all data in one file
backup.fact1: One consistent snapshot of every table with a SHA-256 per table.
backup.fact2: Before a restore the file is checked in full; after loading, the data is exported again and matched byte for byte, and the audit chain verified, or nothing changes.
backup.fact3: A daily automatic copy, plus a safety copy before any restore, when a backup folder is set (automatic in the desktop app).
backup.restoreWarning: Restoring replaces all current data with the backup and signs every user out.
backup.confirmText: All current data will be replaced by the backup of {{date}}. Only restoring another backup can undo this. Continue?

build.title: How Yusr is built
build.intro: Independent layers, one job each, each tested on its own

domain.title: Domain rules
domain.text: Fund accounting, zakat, Hijri calendar, e-invoicing and the audit chain, with no database or network, so they test precisely.

infra.title: Data layer
infra.text: PostgreSQL with SERIALIZABLE transactions, triggers that make the books and audit log write-once, and verified backups.

server.title: Server & API
server.text: A REST API with a permission per operation, Argon2id passwords, replay protection and strict security headers.

web.title: Interface
web.text: An Arabic/English web app for phone and desktop, with A4 reports, printing, export and keyboard shortcuts.

desktop.title: Desktop app
desktop.text: A self-contained Windows MSI with the database, server, interface and local model; works offline.

advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.text: A local language model that reads only a summary of what the user may see, and gives alerts and suggestions with no power to act.

principles.ledger: Entries are never deleted or edited; corrections are reversing entries.
principles.audit: Every operation joins a hash-chained audit trail that exposes tampering.
principles.security: A permission per operation; the server always decides.
principles.money: Money is exact decimals, never floating point.
principles.tests: Unit tests, integration tests on a real database and browser tests.
